description: Is this operator in Japan's official MAFF list of organic JAS certified operators (domestic or foreign)? Look up by certification number, operator name (2+ chars, organizations only), country, prefecture, category or certifier. Returns found, no_longer_listed (reason not published or inferred), no_match_in_checked_list (does not mean not organic) or unknown, with certifier, category, municipality or country, certified_on, first/last seen. Confirm with the certification body.

certification_number.description: Certification number as published by the certification body, e.g. 060420-001 (numbers can repeat across bodies; add certifier to narrow)

certifier.description: Part of the registered certification body's name, e.g. Ecocert or アファス

country.description: Country: ISO code (CN), English name (China) or Japanese name (中国). JP = the domestic list

operator_name.description: Part of the operator name in Japanese or Latin letters, at least 2 characters (organization names only)

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture (Tokyo or 東京都), JIS code (13) or local government code (130001); domestic listings only

product_category.description: Product category: agricultural_products, processed_foods, feeds, livestock_products, algae (or the Japanese name, e.g. 有機加工食品)

name: organic_jas_lookup

certification_number.description: Certification number as published (assigned by each certification body; can repeat across bodies; empty for some rows).

listed.description: true = in the current official list.

listing_id.description: This service's id for the listing (d-... domestic, f-... foreign).

operator_name.description: Operator name as published; null when withheld (name_withheld).

certification_number.description: Certification number as published (assigned by each certification body; can repeat across bodies; empty for some rows).

listed.description: true = in the current official list.

listing_id.description: This service's id for the listing (d-... domestic, f-... foreign).

operator_name.description: Operator name as published; null when withheld (name_withheld).

official_check.description: Read first: confirm with the certification body or on the official MAFF page listed here before relying on this answer.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

registry_status.description: The common registry status section shared across this operator's servers (listed / not_found_in_checked_records / no_longer_listed_since / unknown; expired is never used here). Null for list queries that do not identify an operator (country, prefecture, category or certifier only).

status.description: found = in the current official list; no_longer_listed = seen by this service before but not in the current list (reason not published, not inferred); no_match_in_checked_list = not in the list versions checked and not seen since tracking_since (does not mean not organic); unknown = list not loaded yet or stale. Never 'expired'.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.
